quarterly_data.signal: Trial authorisation for the in-licensed HRS-1596 (once-weekly oral GLP-1/GIP dual receptor agonist, phase 1-ready): Hengrui Pharma has received approval in China to initiate phase 1 clinical trials with HRS-1596 for weight management and type 2 diabetes; the company says HRS-1596 is designed to reduce weight and improve glycemic control and has potential use in obesity, type 2 diabetes and other metabolic diseases.
quarterly_data.figure: China approval to initiate phase 1 trials (weight management and type 2 diabetes)
